name: Lead Generation Form
author: FARAZFRANK

sections.description:
Lead Generation Form is the ultimate WordPress plugin for capturing and managing leads. With a drag-and-drop form builder, you can create stunning, customizable forms to convert visitors into leads.

Key features include:

  • Drag-and-Drop Interface: Build forms effortlessly.
  • Analytics Dashboard: Track form submissions and leads.
  • Spam Protection: Built-in Google reCAPTCHA and honeypot protection.
  • Email Notifications: Get instant alerts for new leads.
  • Export Options: Download leads in Excel/CSV format.
  • Seamless Integration: Works with all major WordPress themes and page builders like Elementor and Gutenberg.

Perfect for businesses, bloggers, and marketers, this plugin helps you grow your email list and convert visitors into customers. Try it today and start generating leads!

How Lead Generation Form works?

Go to the plugin dashboard and click on ‘Create New Form’ or go directly to the ‘Form Generator’ menu.
First, type a name for your form.
Use the fields menu on the right sidebar to drag and drop the fields you want into your form.
Configure each field’s settings, such as whether it’s required, its label, help text (tooltip), placeholder text, class, name, value, and type.
Make sure to add a single Submit button to the form.
Once you’ve finished building the form, click the “Save Form” button.
This will save your form and generate a shortcode for it.
Copy the shortcode, which will look like [WLFG id=’7′], and paste it into a new page or post to display your form.

Watch the easy video tutorial to learn more about plugin installation

How many types of field support by this dynamic form builder plugin?

You can create following types of fields:

  • Heading Tags H1, H2, H3, H4, H5 and H6
  • Paragraph
  • Textbox
  • Password
  • Email
  • Color
  • Telephone
  • Date
  • Number
  • Range
  • Textarea
  • Select
  • Radio
  • Checkbox
  • File
  • Submit Button

What type of Forms you can create using this Form Builder plugin?

You can create and publish variety of Forms, like:

  • User Registration Form
  • Bike Rental Form
  • Car Rental Form
  • Lead Capture Form
  • Customer Feedback Form
  • Product Review Form
  • Portfolio Upload Form
  • Online Booking Form
  • Appointment Scheduling Form
  • Seat Reservation Form
  • Class Registration Form
  • Customer Interest Form
  • Doctor Appointment Form
  • Book A Consultant Form
  • Travel Reservation Form
  • Student Registration Form
  • Hostel Booking Form
  • Event Registration Form
  • Job Fair Registration Form
  • Document Verification Form
  • Age Verification Form

Free Plugin Features

  • Responsive Design

Forms are mobile-friendly and adapt to any screen size, ensuring a seamless user experience on all devices.

  • Easy Shortcode Customization

Quickly embed forms on pages or posts using shortcodes. Customize each shortcode to fit specific pages without modifying the main form.

  • Clone Feature

Duplicate existing forms with a single click, saving time when you need multiple similar forms.

  • Dynamic Form Builder

Create fully customized forms using a drag-and-drop interface, making it simple to add, reorder, and configure fields.

  • Unlimited Forms Creation

There’s no limit to the number of forms you can create, allowing you to cater to various needs across your website.

  • Easy Forms Management (CRUD)

Effortlessly manage forms with options to create, update, delete, and clone, all from a centralized dashboard.

  • Form Shortcode

Each form generates a unique shortcode, making it easy to embed forms in posts, pages, or widgets.

  • Custom Shortcode Parameters

Configure shortcode parameters such as id, blacklist, reply_field_name, and reply_field_email for advanced customization.

  • Copy Form Shortcode Button

Copy shortcodes to your clipboard instantly with a dedicated button, simplifying the embedding process.

  • Simple Drag and Drop UI

The intuitive drag-and-drop builder makes form creation accessible to users of all skill levels.

  • Simple Analytics Dashboard

Get a quick overview of form submissions and leads, enabling data-driven decisions.

  • Customer Query Management

Organize and manage all customer inquiries in one place, making it easy to track and respond to leads.

  • Search and Sort Queries

Easily find specific customer inquiries using search and sort functionality.

  • Leads Management

Access and manage all captured leads and customer data for better engagement and follow-up.

  • Export Queries (Excel/CSV)

Download all customer data in Excel or CSV format for further analysis or integration with other systems.

  • Form Import and Export

Move forms between websites or backup form settings with easy import and export options.

  • Combine Forms

Merge two forms into one, allowing for flexible form structures and comprehensive data collection.

  • Google reCAPTCHA v3 coming soon

Protect your forms from spam with integrated Google reCAPTCHA v3, offering a secure experience for genuine users.

  • Honeypot Spam Protection

Add an extra layer of security with honeypot fields to trap bots.

  • Email Notifications

Get notified of new submissions via email using WP Mail or SMTP, ensuring timely responses to leads.

  • Admin Notification

Automatically alert the administrator when a new query is submitted, helping you stay on top of customer inquiries.

  • Blacklist Emails and Domains

Prevent spam by blocking specific emails and domains, keeping your inbox clean.

  • User Submission Message

Display a custom message to users upon successful submission, enhancing the user experience.

  • Adaptive Styling

Forms automatically adapt to the active theme’s styling, ensuring a cohesive design across your site.

  • Widget Support

Easily add forms to sidebars and other widgetized areas for increased visibility and convenience.

  • 100 Leads Display Limit

View up to 100 leads in the dashboard, offering quick access to recent submissions.

  • 100 Leads Export Limit

Export up to 100 leads at a time in Excel or CSV format for streamlined data management.

  • Support via WordPress Forum

Access community support through the WordPress support forum for guidance and troubleshooting.

Pro Plugin Features

  • Unlimited Lead Capture & Lead Form

No cap on the number of leads captured, ideal for growing businesses.

  • Unlimited Lead Lists Export

Export unlimited leads in Excel or CSV format, supporting in-depth analysis and integration.

  • Automated SPAM Protection

Our plugin has auto detect mechanism to protect from spam bots and miscellaneous scripts.

  • Add CC Emails

Through carbon_copy parameter in shortcode you send multiple copies to alternative email accounts. Example shortcode to add CC emails:[WLFG id=’1′ carbon_copy=’one@example.com, two@example.com’]

  • Blacklist Emails and Domains

Through blacklist parameter in shortcode you can block emails and domains names to access the forms. Example shortcode to block email and domains: blacklist=’abc@mail.ru, xyz@list.ru, mail.ru, list.ru’.

  • Priority Support

Get faster, priority support through a dedicated helpdesk, ensuring quick resolution for any issues.

3rd Party Services

  • Google reCAPTCHA v3

We are using Google reCAPTCHA v3 to prevent unauthorized access to the form generated by plugin.
We have setting to configure Google reCAPTCHA v3 by users own credential.

sections.installation:
• Upload plugin files to your plugins folder, or install using WordPress built-in Add New Plugin installer;
  • Activate the plugin;
  • Navigate to Plugin Settings and fill settings.
sections.faq:
Q: How to install plugin?

  • A: Download the plugin zip file. Login to you website and go to Plugins > Add New > click on Upload Plugin button and provide the zip file path and hit the Install Now button. After successful installation activate the plugin.

Q: Is this plugin compatible with Elementor and Gutenberg?

  • A: Yes, it works seamlessly with all major page builders.

Q: Does it have spam protection?

  • A: Yes, it includes Google reCAPTCHA v3 and honeypot protection.

Q:What is the plugin license?

  • A: GPL license.
